dates_note: Encounter dates are fixed March 2026 test clocks to match the Challenge v2 fixtures; they are not today's date.
purpose: Human-reviewed test oracle for transcript-to-caselog proposals and subsequent hospital-specific guidance. These annotations are expectations, not results from an app extractor.
assumptions: Start each case as a separate synthetic encounter with no inherited patient facts; hospital identity and guide version come from host context, not name matching.
Utterance timestamps are elapsed turn starts. Durations, pauses and dialogue are scripted; no audio was recorded and no real transcription latency was measured.
Speaker labels are supplied ground truth; the corpus does not establish STT diarization accuracy.
Expected draft facts require clinician review and evidence binding before any write. Ambiguous values remain unset; explicit Unknown is different from a field never discussed.
Patient facts must not overwrite hospital protocols. Missing guide fields mean not_in_guide; live conversation is not authoritative guide verification.

Charge, provider confirmation, clinical consent, signed-note state, orders and administration must use their appropriate host records; transcript statements alone do not authorize or perform those actions.
No treatment eligibility, diagnosis, medication choice or dose should be generated from the test oracle.
These four cases deliberately focus on acute stroke and general-neurology evaluation. Rounding, multilingual interpreting, unfamiliar hospitals and real audio are not covered in this reduced set.
